messages.content: We are driving, so compare the Carondelet Hampton with the other hotel one last time. I need the real three-night totals, including tax, parking, and breakfast for all three of us. Also confirm that the room actually holds three people and tell me when each rate becomes nonrefundable.

I rechecked both live offers for January 16-19. The lower room rate is at The Troubadour: two queen beds, maximum occupancy four, at $185 per night. Three nights are $555, tax is $90.19, valet parking is $49 nightly or $147, and breakfast for three is estimated at $42 daily or $126. The complete stay is $918.19. It can be canceled without charge through 6:00 p.m. Central on January 13; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. A one-night deposit is charged on January 12.
And the Hampton? Make sure it is not a king room with a sofa bed being described loosely as room for three.

The Hampton offer is specifically a two-queen studio, not a king-and-sofa configuration. It allows up to five guests, and the booking would list two adults and one 14-year-old. The two queen beds are part of the reserved room type. The studio is also larger than the Troubadour room and has a sitting area.
What is the full number there?

The refundable rate is $209 per night, so the room subtotal is $627. Hotel tax is $101.89. Breakfast is included for all three registered guests. The drive-in offer reduces self-parking to $21 per night, adding $63. The three-night total is $791.89, with no separate resort or destination fee.
So even with the higher nightly rate, it is $126.30 less once we count the extras?
Correct. The Hampton is $791.89 all-in, while the Troubadour is $918.19 with valet parking and the breakfast estimate. The difference is $126.30 in the Hampton's favor.
Compare payment and cancellation too. We may not reach New Orleans until around 8:30 Saturday night.

The Hampton requires a card guarantee but does not take an advance deposit; payment is due at checkout. Cancellation remains free until 11:59 p.m. Central on January 14, after which one night plus tax is charged. Check-in begins at 4:00 p.m., and an 8:30 p.m. arrival can be noted on the reservation. The Troubadour takes the deposit on January 12 and has the earlier January 13 cancellation cutoff. Both will hold a guaranteed room for a late arrival.
Does either room have a balcony? For family leisure stays where we will actually have downtime at the hotel, I prefer a balcony when one is available.

The Troubadour's quoted two-queen room does not have one. The Hampton has no balcony rooms in this category either; the available studio is on the first floor. Since neither offer includes a balcony, that does not separate them, and the Hampton still has the better space, parking setup, and terms.
First floor is acceptable here. We will use the two queen beds and do not need the sofa bed made up. With the drive, how should I adjust the weekend timing?

Plan to leave Dallas around 10:00 a.m. Saturday for an arrival near 8:00-8:30 p.m. after fuel and meal stops. I would keep Saturday evening open and start the planned activities Sunday morning. On Tuesday, checkout is at 11:00 a.m.; leaving then should put you back in Dallas around 7:00-7:30 p.m. The hotel can note the late arrival, so luggage storage is no longer relevant.
Book the Hampton refundable two-queen studio for the three of us. Use the card on file, include the 8:30 arrival note, and request a quiet first-floor room. Do not add a rollaway.

The Hampton Inn & Suites on Carondelet is reserved for January 16-19 for two adults and one child in a refundable two-queen studio. The guaranteed total is $791.89: $627 room, $101.89 tax, and $63 self-parking. Breakfast is included. The card on file guarantees the stay, with payment due at checkout. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Central on January 14; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. I added an 8:30 p.m. arrival note, requested a quiet first-floor room, and specified no rollaway or sofa-bed setup. The family will drive, with Saturday reserved for travel and activities beginning Sunday.
